content: Vano Yakopi aheehana asaanawe ni weerelaca: Mmwaace woono wiira kuuhimeryeni citthu cinhala wuukhumelelani uhoolo.

content.text: Nthukumanace va wiira mwiiwe nyu asaana a Yakopi,
ikuru caka, nhokorokho woopacera wo mwiirutthuni mwaka,
Unaviluwa toko maasi. Khunkhalana tho iyuulupale
kontha we uhowela ikori ya athumwana;
Simiyoni ni Levi ari ntthu ni munnaawe,
ikatana caya nnyo ciri ikaruma cookhwiri.
Akintthuna upanka mphantte miruku caya nnyo,
nuusama waya nwo ahokwanyulaca ni uthikilaca mitinka imope.
ntata naa ninaahala wavara nsiko eenani aa,
asaana a Yakopi anaahala umoromela Yutta wiitho wawe.
we, mwamwanaka, uneetta toko kharamu oovara.
Unonkoma toko kharamu nlopwana ni unrupa
Nttontto wo omwene khunhala unkhuma Yutta,
hata ikopo yo nlamulo khinhala unkhuma mmatatani mwa,
ni uyo naahala ulemelihiya ni ilapo cothene.
Yooyo naahala untthukelela puuru awe wanrittani woolipa;
ikuwo cawe naahala ukattha ni ivinyu,
iphome yo uva inamwareela nkuwoni mwawe.
Miitho awe ankootepa uriipa woopwaha ivinyu.
Miino awe utepa utteela woopwaha iphepa.
Oonaka wiira nipuro nimmumulawe nno niri nooreera
Tani naahala waakihera citthu cikhanle coneethi awe
toko nihimo phi nihimo no Isirayeli.
Tani nokokhala toko mwiikhomya unceresere iparapara,
Kaate naahala wananiinya ikhotto ni miphwinko,
nanso uyo phinhala waatthema ni woomolanihaca.
Meeca a Aseri anhala ucara coolya;
Yooyo phinhala uvaha coolya co mamwene.
Nafitali ri toko naahe ookwattula muntthapweni,
miritta caya nnyo cinavira waculu waya isiri.
anvonyeraka myuupa caya nnyo wo nceece.
myoono cawe ciri cokuru ni cowoorya uvonya myuupa,
mwanlattu wo ntata na muulupale a Yakopi
mwancina na nhakheli, mwala wo Isirayeli.
Mwancina na Nluku a athumwane, ookavihere we,
cennya iparakha nnya cothene cirwee mwiirutthuni mwa Yusufu.
Cirwee uhoolo wawe ule aakhanle oomwalanihinya na asunnawe.

content: Ari phi yaala ala apankile mahimo khumi na meeli o Israyeli. Ciicammo athumwanaya phaahimenryaya wowavahaca iparakha, avahiyaka khula ntthu iparakha camwaacile.
Wahoolo Yakopi ahaattonkela asaanawe eerelaka: Kihanle vakani urwaa wa amuci aka akhwile khalayi. Mwakivithe wamoca ni miyapaapa nnikhukuni niri imatta ya Foromi nHitiita.
Nikhuku niri imatta yo Makipela, vakhiviru ni uManree, uKanaa, imatta Aparahamu inthumanannyawe Foromi, nhitita, aaceraka wiira akhale mahiye a amuci awe othene.
Wonwo hovithiya Aparahamu na amwaarawe, Isaki na amwaarawe. Ciicammo wonwo kihonvitha Leya.
Ukhuma imatta eyo ni nikhuku niri mmattani mmo cothene aathumananinye ahitita.
Aanowiira amalihaka wattonkela asaana awe nnya citthu nnya, Yakopi aheecatalela nuukhwa. Vano aahovithiya wamoca na amuci awe.
